allow.openapi.json: Load-bearing OpenAPI source for scripts/repo/generate-sdk.mts, generate-types.mts, and generate-strict-types.mts, which resolve it at the repo root.
allow.openapi-v1.json: OpenAPI v1 snapshot read by scripts/repo/openapi-contracts.mts to generate and check types/api-v1.d.ts.
allow.types: Published declarations: api.d.ts, api-v1.d.ts, and api-helpers.d.ts ship through package.json files[] and their ./types/* exports.
